issues.problem: The Chinese translation restricted changes in the wind to changes in direction.
issues.resolution: The translation now says 风的每一次突然变化, preserving the broader English meaning; independently reread and approved.

issues.problem: The Chinese translation used the door classifier 扇 with 门口, which is not natural Chinese.
issues.resolution: The translation now uses 那处门口; independently reread and approved.

issues.problem: The phrase stretched beyond anything we could see was an unnatural description of the sea extending to the horizon.
issues.resolution: The English now says stretched as far as we could see, with a matching Chinese translation 一望无际; independently reread and approved.

issues.problem: The initial definition described an intelligent person, while the example described a sensible action.
issues.resolution: The definition now says 体现明智判断的 and matches the selected use; independently reread and approved.

issues.problem: The Chinese phrase 轻轻的音乐 was an unnatural rendering of quiet music.
issues.resolution: The translation now uses 轻声播放的音乐 and a natural description of the relaxed atmosphere; independently reread and approved.
